questions.prompt: Write one sentence of exactly 10 words in which the first word has 1 letter, the second word has 2 letters, the third has 3 letters, and so on up to a tenth word with 10 letters.
questions.reference: I am the best baker around, serving aromatic delicious croissants.

questions.prompt: Write one sentence of exactly 26 words in which the first word starts with A, the second with B, the third with C, and so on through the alphabet to a last word starting with Z.
questions.reference: A big cat danced elegantly, flipping gracefully, happily ignoring jealous kittens lurking, meowing noisily, only pausing quietly, resting silently, then unexpectedly vaulting with xenial youthful zeal.

questions.prompt: Write exactly 4 sentences about winter. Every sentence must have exactly 10 words. You may not use the letter 'e' or the letter 'a' anywhere.
questions.reference: Cold winds blow through this thin wood with icy fury. Snow sits thick upon roofs, posts, fords, tools, logs, rocks. Kids build tiny forts, simply shouting with joy until dusk. Soon morning sun will glow on frost, bright but cold.

questions.prompt: Write exactly 6 lines. Line 1 must have exactly 1 word, line 2 exactly 2 words, and so on up to line 6 with exactly 6 words. Every line must end with a question mark. No word may appear more than once in your whole reply. You may not use the letter 's' anywhere.
questions.reference:
Why?
Really now?
Could you play?
Where did Bob go?
Can a red bird fly?
Will any tall elk run home?

questions.prompt: Reply with a single line that is exactly 50 characters long, counting every letter, space and punctuation mark. It must contain exactly 9 words and end with a period.
questions.reference: The quick brown fox jumped over those sleepy dogs.

questions.prompt: Write one sentence of exactly 12 words, all in lowercase, that contains the letter 'z' exactly 5 times in total.
questions.reference: the dizzy zebra gazed at a furry cat near the old zoo.

questions.prompt: Write a poem of exactly 5 lines. Every line must have exactly 6 words. The last words of the five lines must be, in this order: moon, river, stone, moon, light. Every line must begin with a vowel (a, e, i, o or u). Do not use any commas.
questions.reference:
Under the quiet sky the moon
Enters softly beside the silver river
Old shadows rest upon cold stone
Above us drifts a pale moon
Every wave returns its borrowed light

questions.prompt: Write a tiny story of exactly 3 sentences and exactly 30 words in total. No word may be longer than 4 letters. No word may be used more than once. The story must include the words 'frog' and 'lamp'.
questions.reference: A tiny frog sat on the old lamp post at dusk. It saw two red ants move past his damp gray foot. Then rain fell hard, and all went dark.
